title: remove_exploration_context inputSchema
description: Argument shape for remove_exploration_context (composition profile, ADR-0032). Removes one exploration context, by id, from a composition document's `explorationContexts` collection. Target addressing matches create_exploration_context: a composition document (mapPackageId or appPackageId) at the standard level, with the reference implementation's draft-lifecycle spelling (draftId + generation) admitted as x-honua-reference-shape. Removing an unknown explorationContextId is an error, not a no-op. Removing a context leaves every component that names it bound to nothing, so an implementation MUST either reject the removal or clear those bindings with it — silently orphaning a binding is not conformant. See docs/adr/0032-shared-exploration-contexts.md.

mapPackageId.description: Target MapPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

appPackageId.description: Target AppPackage composition document. Exactly one of mapPackageId / appPackageId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

explorationContextId.description: Id of the exploration context to remove.

cascadeBindings.description: When true, every component naming this context has its explorationContextId and role cleared, leaving the components in place and independent. When false (default), the call fails while any component is still bound, so a document never silently retains an unresolvable binding. This mirrors remove_control's cascadeInteractions.
